recommendation: Keep this audit commit and preserve the distinction between MeasureReport.date and MeasureReport.group.calculatedDate unless a future CQI decision changes it.
issue_request: FHIR-41018 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core MeasureReport issue for R6 requesting that MeasureReport.date be changed back to report generation timing and that a group-level calculatedDate dateTime element be added for calculation timing.
initial_application: Commit 45610ce7d2cc50ef0749c364466698ab13d0b31b and PR HL7/fhir#3312 applied the issue by changing MeasureReport.date back to generated and adding MeasureReport.group.calculatedDate in source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-20804 originally changed the R5 root date wording to calculated. FHIR-40797 later explained why generated and calculated dates need to be distinguished, motivating the FHIR-41018 core follow-up.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current in-scope MeasureReport StructureDefinition and active fhir.ini entries already match FHIR-41018.
